caption: The video captures a close, eye-level view of deep-frying already underway in a dim, busy kitchen. A black long-handled wok sits steadily over an open gas flame, its contents submerged in vigorously bubbling hot oil. A reddish triangular piece rests toward the right while pale strips and legs float near the top. The bubble pattern constantly churns and reshapes, and the fried pieces bob and drift slightly within the boiling liquid, agitated by the heat rather than any visible stirring. Around the wok, the flames flicker and change shape frame to frame, sometimes licking higher up the left or right rim and sometimes flaring tall behind the pan. Steam and smoke rise in varying density from the oil and from a metal pot at the right edge. At the left, a person in a red apron remains partly visible, with arm and torso shifting only slightly and no cooking tool touching the wok. A wooden-handled metal ladle rests on the stove in the lower foreground throughout the excerpt.
relations: Open flame beneath the wok transfers heat to the oil, driving continuous bubbling that agitates the submerged pieces.
The reddish triangular piece and pale strips bob and drift within the churning oil without visible stirring.
Gas flames flicker and reshape around the wok rim, varying in height from frame to frame.
Steam and smoke rise from the hot oil and the adjacent metal pot, drifting upward in the dim kitchen.
